verdict.rationale: The Teams developer platform docs list a dedicated 'Agent slash commands' page alongside message extensions, so this is a first-party capability for developer-defined commands. The evidence is only navigation titles, though, with no detail on how commands are registered (e.g., manifest), how users invoke them from the compose box, or any limits. Missing for 10: documented registration mechanism, description of message-box invocation and command handling, scope beyond agents/bots, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
